name: Perturbed-Attention Guidance (core)
plain: An extra positive pass with one self-attention block disabled. The difference between the normal and the broken pass adds structural guidance on top of CFG. The core node is locked to the SD UNet middle block.
math:
x̂_pag = M(x; c) with attn1 of block middle/0 replaced: attn(q,k,v) → v
x̂ = x̂_cfg + w·(x̂_c − x̂_pag)
label: from code
surprise: The patch is keyed to UNet middle block 0, so on DiT models with no such attn1 key it does nothing except cost a pass (inference from the patch key).
